messages:
Miriam: quick sync — need to finalize handshake between hosted/dedicated/private. RFC follow-up. Main gaps: auth propagation, attestation for air-gapped, billing attribution, and explicit capability vector. Who's got time for focused review?

Chris: +1. My big worry is auth propagation. If a private runtime uses customer-managed KMS and local IAM, controlplane shouldn't store keys. We currently annotate runtime with `kms:external:true` but need stronger contract for token exchange and TTL.

Raj: propose keeping the handshake minimal: capability vector + opaque secret refs + opt-in constraints. Example manifest we could exchange:

```json
{
  "runtime_id": "redwood-runtime-42",
  "capabilities": ["kv-cache","quant-int8","streaming"],
  "secret_refs": ["kms://customer-a/key-abc"],
  "routing_tiers": ["dedicated", "hosted-fallback"],
  "constraints": {"no_cross_route": true}
}
```

Leslie: billing note — need `metering_id` or `billing_account` surface so requests routed through dedicated are correctly attributed. Also `quota_enforcement`: boolean.

Miriam: fallback semantics are crucial. If hosted can't serve, route to dedicated variant with `routing_tier` fallback. But we need versioned capabilities — `capabilities:v2` — so we don't silently route to an incompatible runtime.

Oliver: ops concern: add `health_probe` URL and `grace_period_seconds` before failover. Also customers under compliance will require `no_cross_route` true by default.

Chris: air-gapped/private edge-case — controlplane may not be able to talk to runtime. We should support a pull model where private runtimes periodically pull manifests and then post a signed attestation blob when they next contact controlplane. Can't rely on synchronous RPC.

Miriam: thinking state machine: ADVERTISED -> REQUESTED -> ATTESTED. Include sequence numbers and signed timestamps for replay protection. Also version fields for `capabilities_schema_version`.

Raj: I'll draft the state machine section in the RFC. Example pseudo:

```python
states = ["advertised","requested","attested"]

def transition(s, event):
    # controlplane requests attestation -> runtime signs blob
    pass

# on attested: store attestation_blob and mark runtime as active:v{n}
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created branch `rfc/handshake-sm` with initial draft — https://git.internal/r/rfcs/handshake-sm

Leslie: SG. I'll own billing test plan. We need unit tests for: metering_id propagation, fallback routing correctness, and compatibility checks when capabilities schema changes.

Miriam: thanks all. @Chris @Raj please add your auth/token exchange snippet + attestation example to the draft by EOD. I'll update diagrams and ping infra.
